svg.text: GHOSTED: The Panel, model sheet v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Upright, neutral, symmetric turnarounds (rest). Body map v1 landmarks. Direction A. Palette rows only. Poses and tilts are in their own panels.
22 #2B1E16 the Camera-Off box; ink outline, eyes, mouths, glasses
12 #FFE8A6 box icon; CF bow + band, blouse V
25 #4A3226 hair: both (CF swept back + bun, WB flat-top)
EACH ONE ALONE (with the chair, no table): front, 3/4, side, back. Culture Fit | Whiteboard | the Camera-Off One (on the table top line)
MOTION (front; red: the pivot). Upper bodies on a piece of the table. Rest head set: chin-up 8 deg.
THE BOX BLINKS (decal swap, about 0.5 s on / 0.5 s off)
ALL LEAN IN: 'any questions for us?'
pivot: elbow line (people), bottom front edge (box)
EXPRESSIONS (front). Mouths: closed line or Ricky style (dark fill, teeth band). No fringe; nothing beside the eyes.

LINEUPS AT THE GAME CAMERA (x1.5): the set estimate + Kit in front, on the real Juno v1 renders (whole cast). Path render: colour, grey. Grass render (set on the path strip beside the cast): colour, grey.
box 22 vs table 24: 11.11:1 (the strongest value step in the set); box 22 vs wood 5 would be 2.19:1. Icon 12 vs box 22: 13.34:1.
table 24 vs grass 1: 1.12:1; vs path 3: 1.00:1 (low: the table reads by its ink edge and the shaded front panel).
CF lilac 10 vs table 24: 1.46:1; vs hair 25: 5.58:1; bow 12 vs hair 25: 9.77:1; lilac 10 vs Dot 11: 2.78:1.
WB vest 26 vs table 24: 7.35:1; shirt 8 vs vest 26: 5.90:1; vest 26 vs Ricky 17: 1.27:1; shirt 8 vs Kit 14: 2.62:1.
